# Sombra

> Post-quantum private UTXO transfers on Solana. Signature-free ownership
> proofs via Kyber-768 and RISC0 STARKs. Built by Bonsol Labs.

Sombra is a privacy layer for Solana that ships quantum-safe cryptography from
day one. Transactions are signature-free - ownership is proven via zero-knowledge
proofs of knowledge, not digital signatures. Amount privacy is per-UTXO, distinct
from the shielded-pool model used by Zcash.

## Core docs
- [Whitepaper](https://sombra.tech/whitepaper.pdf): Full protocol specification (PDF)
- [Homepage](https://sombra.tech): Product overview, how it works, waitlist
- [Full content index](https://sombra.tech/llms-full.txt): Plain-text version of site content for LLM ingestion

## Key facts
- Network: Solana
- Launch: Mainnet beta, Q2 2026
- Post-quantum KEM: Kyber-768 (NIST ML-KEM-768 standard)
- AEAD encryption: ChaCha20-Poly1305
- Proof system: RISC0 STARKs (zero-knowledge, quantum-resistant)
- Transaction model: UTXO with per-UTXO amount privacy
- Ownership model: Signature-free (ZK proof of knowledge of Kyber secret key)
- GPU proof time: ~2 seconds on RTX 3090

## Differentiators
- Only post-quantum privacy protocol on Solana
- Per-UTXO amount privacy, not a shielded pool
- Signature-free ownership proofs
- Solana-native - no bridges, no wrapped tokens

## Parent organization
- [Bonsol Labs](https://bonsol.org): Zero-knowledge infrastructure for Solana. Publishes Sombra and the Bonsol ZK coprocessor.
